note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground in the Sierra Madre west of Saratoga, reached by county roads 500 and 405 then 5 miles of Forest Road 452. Sites in the conifers on the west side of the Jack Creek valley; the creek runs through a willow bottom below. Primitive roads nearby are open to OHV riding, and the Continental Divide Trail is close. --Claude
summary: FS (updated 2026-06-18) + rec.gov 10243223 read: 16 sites (4 pull-through), driveways 23-99 ft, $14 + $5 extra vehicle; rec.gov sells sites 9-16 in the 06-01..09-07 peak season, the rest first-come (stored reservable false/always -> true/some_sites); season mid-June-Oct added; potable water conflicting (cleared). Unsourced '~22 ft limit' dropped from note. Phone empty -> 307-326-5258. Pin OK; not waterfront holds.
flags: BOOKING CHANGED: stored reservable false / fcfs always (from note prose) -> reservable true, recreation.gov, fcfs some_sites: the catalog marks sites 009-016 reservable, the search record says reservable true (Site-Specific), and June 2027 shows those 8 as NYR (not yet released) with 001-008 'Not Reservable'. The FS page says nothing about reservations. Rec.gov rules also carry an odd reservationCutOff {value 7, units 'Not Reservable'} - not written.

POTABLE WATER CONFLICT: the FS amenity block (updated 2026-06-18) says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' while the FS and rec.gov descriptions list 'water'; stored derived true cleared to unknown. Trash: FS says 'trash services', rec.gov 'Trash Service is NOT Provided'. Stay limit: FS 16 days, rec.gov 14 (16 written as max_stay, both in booking.note).

FIT: the stored note and inclusion_evidence claim a 'posted ~22 ft limit' - neither the FS page nor rec.gov posts any limit; rec.gov driveways are 23-99 ft (13 of 16 are 34 ft+), and 4 sites are pull-through. Suggested inclusion_evidence: 'FS Medicine Bow-Routt Jack Creek page (updated 2026-06-18) + recreation.gov 10243223: 16 drive-in sites incl 4 pull-throughs, driveways 23-99 ft, $14 -> real RV campground that fits a 23-ft rig'.
PHONE: empty -> 307-326-5258 (Brush Creek/Hayden Ranger District, Saratoga; rec.gov facility phone). Websites (FS r02 page + rec.gov 10243223) live and correct.
OHV: FS says the campground 'has primitive roads in the area for OHV riding' - a general campground with OHV access nearby, not a staging camp (no flag beyond this).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront holds - Jack Creek is in a willow bottom ~80-150 m east of the sites. Pin 41.28353,-107.12051 is ~100 m north of the loop's centre (~41.2827,-107.1202) - under the 250 m line, no move.
